title: Consumer Court Awards Tracker: Refund & Compensation Orders
h1: Monthly Tracker of Consumer Commission Orders on Refunds and Compensation
metaTitle: Consumer Court Awards Tracker: Refund & Compensation Orders
metaDescription: A monthly roundup of consumer commission orders against e-commerce sites, airlines, banks and builders, with amounts and links.

dataSources: e-Jagriti Online Redressal System (Ministry of Consumer Affairs)
CONFONET District and State Commission Repositories
National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) Judgments
selectionCriteria: Final orders issued by District, State, or National Consumer Commissions under CPA 2019.
Matters involving complete refund of consideration, statutory compensation, or punitive litigation costs.
Certified or digitally signed orders verifiable via official commission portals.
methodology.verificationMethod: All indexed awards are audited against official court dockets and certified portal case records.
exclusionCriteria: Interim non-dispositive orders or matters subject to appellate stay by SCDRC, NCDRC, or High Courts.
Matters where certified order copies have not yet been made publicly accessible.
